unmodelled.source_quote: Minimum 8th pass required for projects costing above

unmodelled.source_quote: Individuals (including rural and urban unemployed youth)

unmodelled.text: Only new projects; existing units are not eligible

unmodelled.text: Only manufacturing and service sector projects
unmodelled.source_quote: Only manufacturing and service sector projects are covered

unmodelled.text: Units already getting a subsidy under another government scheme are not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Units already availing subsidy under other government schemes are not eligible

en.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
en.benefit: 15% to 35% subsidy on a new micro-enterprise (higher for special categories), with bank loans for most of the project cost.
en.how_to_apply: Apply on the PMEGP e-portal with a project report; KVIC, KVIB or the District Industries Centre reviews it.
